sections.title: Beginning Thai I
sections.description: Beginning Thai I is designed for the beginning students with no previous knowledge of Thai and to introduce course participants to Thai language and culture. In addition to Thai scripts and phonology, this course will introduce vocabulary, simple sentence structures, everyday conversations and various aspects of Thai culture.

sections.title: Beginning Thai I
sections.description: An introduction to the spoken and written Thai language. Beginning Tibetan will explain the fundmentals of the modern Tibetan language in its literary and spoken forms. Students will develop the ability to read the Tibetan script and identify and analyze Tibetan grammatical forms. Students will also learn conversational Tibetan, and be introduced to the structure of spoken grammar and its pronunciation. This class will provide a foundation for reading Tibetan literature, both classical and modern, and for speaking Tibetan.
